title: Chapter 9 – Rāja-Vidya Rāja-Guhya Yoga (The Yoga of Sovereign Knowledge and the Supreme Secret)
subtitle: Yoga of Royal Knowledge and Royal Secret

verses.title: 9.1 idam tu te guhyatamam
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात् ॥ ९-१॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
idaṃ tu te guhyatamaṃ pravakṣyāmyanasūyave
jñānaṃ vijñānasahitaṃ yajjñātvā mokṣyase'śubhāt 9-1
verses.colloquial:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
idam tu te guhya tamam pravakshyaami anasuuyave
jnaanam vijnaana sahitam yat jnaatvaa mokshyase ashubhaat 9-1
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: Because you do not find fault, I will now reveal to you the deepest secret of all: the most profound knowledge joined with direct experience (realisation). Once you have understood it, you will be released from the sorrows of life.

verses.title: 9.2 raja-vidya raja-guhyam
verses.sanskrit:
राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम् ।
प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम् ॥ ९-२॥
verses.roman:
rājavidyā rājaguhyaṃ pavitramidamuttamam
pratyakṣāvagamaṃ dharmyaṃ susukhaṃ kartumavyayam 9-2
verses.colloquial:
raaja vidyaa raaja guhyam pavitram idam uttamam
pratyaksha avagamam dharmyam su sukham kartum avyayam 9-2
verses.translation_reworded: This is the royal science and the royal secret, the highest purifier. It can be known directly through intuition, it accords with DHARMA, it is very easy to practise, and it never perishes.

verses.title: 9.3 ashraddadhanah purusha
verses.sanskrit:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप ।
अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि ॥ ९-३॥
verses.roman:
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā dharmasyāsya parantapa
aprāpya māṃ nivartante mṛtyusaṃsāravartmani 9-3
verses.colloquial:
ashraddadhaanaah purushaa dharmasya asya parantapa
apraapya maam nivartante mrityu samsaara vartmani 9-3
verses.translation_reworded: O Parantapa, those who have no faith in this DHARMA (the Divine Self) fail to reach Me and come back to the road of rebirth, which is full of death.

verses.title: 9.4 maya tatam idam sarvam
verses.sanskrit:
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना ।
मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः ॥ ९-४॥
verses.roman:
mayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadavyaktamūrtinā
matsthāni sarvabhūtāni na cāhaṃ teṣvavasthitaḥ 9-4
verses.colloquial:
mayaa tatam idam sarvam jagad avyaktamuurtinaa
matsthaani sarva bhuutaani na cha aham teshu avasthitah 9-4
verses.translation_reworded: In My Unmanifest form (aspect) I pervade this entire world. Every being exists within Me, yet I do not reside in them.

verses.title: 9.5 na cha mat-sthani
verses.sanskrit:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ।
भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः ॥ ९-५॥
verses.roman:
na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram
bhūtabhṛnna ca bhūtastho mamātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ 9-5
verses.colloquial:
na cha matsthaani bhuutaani pashya me yoga maishvaram
bhuuta bhrinna cha bhuutastho mama aatmaa bhuuta bhaavanah 9-5
verses.translation_reworded: And in truth, beings do not exist in Me either. See My Divine YOGA: I uphold all beings, yet I do not dwell in them. I Myself am the efficient cause of every being.

verses.title: 9.6 yathakasha-sthito
verses.sanskrit:
यथाकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान् ।
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय ॥ ९-६॥
verses.roman:
yathākāśasthito nityaṃ vāyuḥ sarvatrago mahān
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni matsthānītyupadhāraya 9-6
verses.colloquial:
yathaa kaashasthito nityam vaayuh sarvatrago mahaan
tathaa sarvaani bhuutaani matsthaaniiti upadhaaraya 9-6
verses.translation_reworded: Just as the great wind, which moves everywhere, always rests in space (the AKASHA), understand that in the same way all beings rest in Me.

verses.title: 9.7 sarva-bhutani kaunteya
verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम् ।
कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम् ॥ ९-७॥
verses.roman:
sarvabhūtāni kaunteya prakṛtiṃ yānti māmikām
kalpakṣaye punastāni kalpādau visṛjāmyaham 9-7
verses.colloquial:
sarva bhuutaani kaunteya prakritim yaanti maamikaam
kalpa kshaye punah taani kalpa aadau visrijaami aham 9-7
verses.translation_reworded: O Kaunteya (Son of Kunti), when a KALPA ends, all beings pass into My PRAKRITI (nature). When the next KALPA begins, I send them out once more.

verses.title: 9.8 prakritim svam
verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः ।
भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात् ॥ ९-८॥
verses.roman:
prakṛtiṃ svāmavaṣṭabhya visṛjāmi punaḥ punaḥ
bhūtagrāmamimaṃ kṛtsnamavaśaṃ prakṛtervaśāt 9-8
verses.colloquial:
prakritim svaam avashtabhya visrijaami punah punah
bhuuta graamam imam kritsnam avasham prakriter vashaat 9-8
verses.translation_reworded: Giving life to My PRAKRITI, I send forth this whole helpless crowd of beings again and again, through the power of nature (PRAKRITI).

verses.title: 9.9 na cha mam tani
verses.sanskrit:
न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय ।
उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु ॥ ९-९॥
verses.roman:
na ca māṃ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya
udāsīnavadāsīnam asaktaṃ teṣu karmasu 9-9
verses.colloquial:
na cha maam taani karmaani nibadhnanti dhananjaya
udaasiina vad aasiinam asaktam teshu karmasu 9-9
verses.translation_reworded: Dhananjaya, I sit as if unconcerned, with no attachment to these acts, and so these acts do not bind Me.

verses.title: 9.10 mayadhyakshena prakritih
verses.sanskrit:
मयाध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम् ।
हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते ॥ ९-१०॥
verses.roman:
mayādhyakṣeṇa prakṛtiḥ sūyate sacarācaram
hetunānena kaunteya jagadviparivartate 9-10
verses.colloquial:
mayaadhyakshena prakritih suuyate sacharaacharam
hetunaanena kaunteya jagat viparivartate 9-10
verses.translation_reworded: With Me presiding over her, PRAKRITI (nature) brings forth everything that moves and everything that does not move. For this reason, O Kaunteya, the world keeps turning.

verses.title: 9.11 avajananti mam mudha
verses.sanskrit:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम् ।
परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम् ॥ ९-११॥
verses.roman:
avajānanti māṃ mūḍhā mānuṣīṃ tanumāśritam
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mama bhūtamaheśvaram 9-11
verses.colloquial:
avajaananti maam muudhaa maanushiim tanum aashritam
param bhaavam ajaananto mama bhuuta maheshvaram 9-11
verses.translation_reworded: Foolish people ignore Me when I live in a human body. They do not recognise My Higher nature as the Great Lord of every being.

verses.title: 9.12 moghasha mogha-karmano
verses.sanskrit:
मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः ।
राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः ॥ ९-१२॥
verses.roman:
moghāśā moghakarmāṇo moghajñānā vicetasaḥ
rākṣasīmāsurīṃ caiva prakṛtiṃ mohinīṃ śritāḥ 9-12
verses.colloquial:
moghaashaa moghakarmaano moghajnaanaa vichetasah
raakshasiim aasuriim cha eva prakritim mohiniim shritaah 9-12
verses.translation_reworded: Their hopes are empty, their actions are empty, their knowledge is empty, and they lack sense. They are truly gripped by the deluding nature of RAKSHASAS and ASURAS.

verses.title: 9.13 mahatmanas tu mam
verses.sanskrit:
महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः ।
भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम् ॥ ९-१३॥
verses.roman:
mahātmānastu māṃ pārtha daivīṃ prakṛtimāśritāḥ
bhajantyananyamanaso jñātvā bhūtādimavyayam 9-13
verses.colloquial:
mahaatmaanas tu maam paartha daiviim prakritim aashritaah
bhajanti ananya manasah jnaatvaa bhuuta aadim avyayam 9-13
verses.translation_reworded: But the MAHATMAS (great souls), O Partha, who share in My divine nature, worship Me with a mind fixed on nothing else, knowing Me as the Imperishable Source of all beings.

verses.title: 9.14 satatam kirtayanto
verses.sanskrit:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः ।
नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ॥ ९-१४॥
verses.roman:
satataṃ kīrtayanto māṃ yatantaśca dṛḍhavratāḥ
namasyantaśca māṃ bhaktyā nityayuktā upāsate 9-14
verses.colloquial:
satatam kiirtayanto maam yatantashcha dridha vrataah
namasyantashcha maam bhaktyaa nitya yuktaa upaasate 9-14
verses.translation_reworded: They constantly sing My glory, make earnest effort, hold firmly to their vows, bow down before Me, and remain always steady; in this way they worship Me with devotion.

verses.title: 9.15 jnana-yajnena chapyanye
verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते ।
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् ॥ ९-१५॥
verses.roman:
jñānayajñena cāpyanye yajanto māmupāsate
ekatvena pṛthaktvena bahudhā viśvatomukham 9-15
verses.colloquial:
jnaana yajnena cha api anye yajanto maam upaasate
ekatvena prithaktvena bahudhaa vishvato mukham 9-15
verses.translation_reworded: Still others worship Me by offering the sacrifice of Wisdom, seeing Me as the One, as the distinct, and as the manifold, I who face in every direction in all My forms.

verses.title: 9.16 aham kratur aham yajnah
verses.sanskrit:
अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम् ।
मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम् ॥ ९-१६॥
verses.roman:
ahaṃ kraturahaṃ yajñaḥ svadhāhamahamauṣadham
mantro'hamahamevājyam ahamagnirahaṃ hutam 9-16
verses.colloquial:
aham kratuh aham yajnah svadhaaham aham aushadham
mantro'ham aham eva aajyam aham agnih aham hutam 9-16
verses.translation_reworded: I am the KRATU; I am the sacrifice; I am the offering (food) given to the PITRIS (ancestors); I am the healing herb and every plant; I am the MANTRA; I am the clarified butter as well; I am the fire; I am the oblation.

verses.title: 9.17 pitaham asya jagato
verses.sanskrit:
पिताहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः ।
वेद्यं पवित्रमोङ्कार ऋक्साम यजुरेव च ॥ ९-१७॥
verses.roman:
pitāhamasya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ
vedyaṃ pavitramoṅkāra ṛksāma yajureva ca 9-17
verses.colloquial:
pitaaham asya jagato maataa dhaataa pitaamahah
vedyam pavitram onkaara rik saama yajuh eva cha 9-17
verses.translation_reworded: I am the Father of this world, and its Mother, its supporter and its grandsire. I am the one Thing worth knowing, the Purifier, the syllable OM, and also the RIK, the SAMA and the YAJUH.

verses.title: 9.18 gatir bharta prabhuh
verses.sanskrit:
गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् ।
प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् ॥ ९-१८॥
verses.roman:
gatirbhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛt
prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam 9-18
verses.colloquial:
gatir bhartaa prabhuh saakshii nivaasah sharanam suhrit
prabhavah pralayah sthaanam nidhaanam biijam avyayam 9-18
verses.translation_reworded: The Goal, the Supporter, the Lord, the Witness: all these are Me. I am the Abode, the Shelter and the Friend; the Origin and the Dissolution; the Foundation, the Treasure-house and the Seed that never perishes.

verses.title: 9.19 tapamyaham aham varsham
verses.sanskrit:
तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च ।
अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन ॥ ९-१९॥
verses.roman:
tapāmyahamahaṃ varṣaṃ nigṛhṇāmyutsṛjāmi ca
amṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuśca sadasaccāhamarjuna 9-19
verses.colloquial:
tapaami aham aham varsham nigrihnaami utsrijaami cha
amritam cha eva mrityuh cha sat asat cha aham arjuna 9-19
verses.translation_reworded: As the Sun, I give out heat; I hold back the rain and I release it. I am Immortality and I am also death; I am both Existence and Non-existence, O Arjuna.

verses.title: 9.20 trai-vidya mam soma-pah
verses.sanskrit:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा
यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते ।
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक-
मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान् ॥ ९-२०॥
verses.roman:
traividyā māṃ somapāḥ pūtapāpā
yajñairiṣṭvā svargatiṃ prārthayante
te puṇyamāsādya surendraloka-
maśnanti divyāndivi devabhogān 9-20
verses.colloquial:
traividyaa maam somapaah puutapaapaa
yajnair ishtvaa svargatim praarthayante
te punyam aasaadya surendra loka-
mashnanti divyaan divi deva bhogaan 9-20
verses.translation_reworded: Those who know the three VEDAS, who drink the SOMA and are cleansed of sin, worship Me through sacrifices and ask for the road to heaven. They arrive in the holy world of the Lord of the gods and there taste the Divine pleasures of the gods.

verses.title: 9.21 te tam bhuktva
verses.sanskrit:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं
क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति ।
एवं त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना
गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते ॥ ९-२१॥
verses.roman:
te taṃ bhuktvā svargalokaṃ viśālaṃ
kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti
evaṃ trayīdharmamanuprapannā
gatāgataṃ kāmakāmā labhante 9-21
verses.colloquial:
te tam bhuktvaa svarga lokam vishaalam
kshiine punye martya lokam vishanti
evam trayii dharmam anuprapannaa
gata aagatam kaama kaamaa labhante 9-21
verses.translation_reworded: After enjoying that vast heavenly world, they re-enter the world of mortals once their merit runs out. So, by following the commands of the three VEDAS and longing for the objects of desire, they end up in the condition of going and returning (SAMSARA).

verses.title: 9.22 ananyash chintayanto
verses.sanskrit:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते ।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥ ९-२२॥
verses.roman:
ananyāścintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate
teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham 9-22
verses.colloquial:
ananyaah chintayanto maam ye janaah paryupaasate
teshaam nitya abhiyuktaanaam yoga kshemam vahaami aham 9-22
verses.translation_reworded: For those who worship Me alone, with thoughts of nothing else, and who are always self-controlled, I provide what they do not yet have (YOGA) and I protect what they already have (KSHEMA).

verses.title: 9.23 ye pyanya-devata
verses.sanskrit:
येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः ।
तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम् ॥ ९-२३॥
verses.roman:
ye'pyanyadevatā bhaktā yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ
te'pi māmeva kaunteya yajantyavidhipūrvakam 9-23
verses.colloquial:
ye'pi anyadevataa bhaktaa yajante shraddhayaa anvitaah
te'pi maam eva kaunteya yajanti avidhi puurvakam 9-23
verses.translation_reworded: Even those devotees who worship other gods with faith are in fact worshipping Me alone, O son of Kunti, though by the wrong method.

verses.title: 9.24 aham hi sarva-yajnanam
verses.sanskrit:
अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च ।
न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते ॥ ९-२४॥
verses.roman:
ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca
na tu māmabhijānanti tattvenātaścyavanti te 9-24
verses.colloquial:
aham hi sarva yajnaanaam bhoktaa cha prabhuh eva cha
na tu maam abhijaananti tattvena atah chyavanti te 9-24
verses.translation_reworded: For I alone am the enjoyer in every sacrifice and the Lord of them all. But they do not know Me in My true Essence, and so they fall (they come back to this mortal world).

verses.title: 9.25 yanti deva-vrata devan
verses.sanskrit:
यान्ति देवव्रता देवान्पितॄन्यान्ति पितृव्रताः ।
भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम् ॥ ९-२५॥
verses.roman:
yānti devavratā devānpitṝnyānti pitṛvratāḥ
bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino'pi mām 9-25
verses.colloquial:
yaanti deva vrataa devaan pitriin yaanti pitri vrataah
bhuutaani yaanti bhuuta ejyaa yaanti mad yaajinah api maam 9-25
verses.translation_reworded: Those who worship the DEVAS, or gods, go to the DEVAS. Those who worship the PITRIS, or ancestors, go to the ancestors. Those who worship the BHUTAS, or elements, go to the BHUTAS. But those who worship Me come to Me.

verses.title: 9.26 patram pushpam phalam
verses.sanskrit:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति ।
तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥ ९-२६॥
verses.roman:
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati
tadahaṃ bhaktyupahṛtamaśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ 9-26
verses.colloquial:
patram pushpam phalam toyam yo me bhaktyaa prayacchati
tadaham bhakti upahritam ashnaami prayata aatmanah 9-26
verses.translation_reworded: When someone offers Me a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water with devotion, I accept that gift, offered with devotion by a pure heart.

verses.title: 9.27 yat karoshi yad ashnasi
verses.sanskrit:
यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत् ।
यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम् ॥ ९-२७॥
verses.roman:
yatkaroṣi yadaśnāsi yajjuhoṣi dadāsi yat
yattapasyasi kaunteya tatkuruṣva madarpaṇam 9-27
verses.colloquial:
yat karoshi yad ashnaasi yaj juhoshi dadaasi yat
yat tapasyasi kaunteya tat kurushva mad arpanam 9-27
verses.translation_reworded: O Kaunteya, whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give away, whatever austerity you practise, do it all as an offering to Me.

verses.title: 9.28 shubhashubha-phalair
verses.sanskrit:
शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः ।
संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि ॥ ९-२८॥
verses.roman:
śubhāśubhaphalairevaṃ mokṣyase karmabandhanaiḥ
saṃnyāsayogayuktātmā vimukto māmupaiṣyasi 9-28
verses.colloquial:
shubha ashubha phalaih evam mokshyase karma bandhanaih
samnyaasa yoga yukta aatmaa vimukto maam upaishyasi 9-28
verses.translation_reworded: In this way you will be released from the bonds of action that produce good and bad results. With your mind firmly set in the YOGA of renunciation, you will be free and will come to Me.

verses.title: 9.29 samo ham sarva-bhuteshu
verses.sanskrit:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः ।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ॥ ९-२९॥
verses.roman:
samo'haṃ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo'sti na priyaḥ
ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpyaham 9-29
verses.colloquial:
samah aham sarva bhuuteshu na me dveshyah asti na priyah
ye bhajanti tu maam bhaktyaa mayi te teshu cha api aham 9-29
verses.translation_reworded: I am the same toward every being; no one is hateful to Me and no one is dear. But those who worship Me with devotion live in Me, and I live in them too.

verses.title: 9.30 api chet su-duracharo
verses.sanskrit:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक् ।
साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः ॥ ९-३०॥
verses.roman:
api cetsudurācāro bhajate māmananyabhāk
sādhureva sa mantavyaḥ samyagvyavasito hi saḥ 9-30
verses.colloquial:
api chet suduraachaaro bhajate maam ananyabhaak
saadhur eva sa mantavyah samyag vyavasito hi sah 9-30
verses.translation_reworded: Even if a person of the worst conduct worships Me with devotion to no one else (with single-pointed focus), that person should indeed be counted as righteous, because he has made the right resolve.

verses.title: 9.31 kshipram bhavati
verses.sanskrit:
क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति ।
कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ॥ ९-३१॥
verses.roman:
kṣipraṃ bhavati dharmātmā śaśvacchāntiṃ nigacchati
kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati 9-31
verses.colloquial:
kshipram bhavati dharmaatmaa shashvacchaantim nigacchati
kaunteya pratijaaniihi na me bhaktah pranashyati 9-31
verses.translation_reworded: He quickly becomes righteous and gains Eternal Peace. O Kaunteya, know this for certain: My devotee is never lost.

verses.title: 9.32 mam hi partha vyapashritya
verses.sanskrit:
मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः ।
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥ ९-३२॥
verses.roman:
māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ
striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste'pi yānti parāṃ gatim 9-32
verses.colloquial:
maam hi paartha vyapaashritya ye'pi syuh paapa yonayah
striyah vaishyaas tathaa shuudraas te'pi yaanti paraam gatim 9-32
verses.translation_reworded: For even those who may be of sinful birth, O Partha, WOMEN, VAISHYAS and SHUDRAS alike, reach the Supreme Goal when they take refuge in Me.

verses.title: 9.33 kim punar brahmanah
verses.sanskrit:
किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा ।
अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम् ॥ ९-३३॥
verses.roman:
kiṃ punarbrāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣayastathā
anityamasukhaṃ lokamimaṃ prāpya bhajasva mām 9-33
verses.colloquial:
kim punar braahmanaah punyaa bhaktaa raajarshayah tathaa
anityam asukham lokam imam praapya bhajasva maam 9-33
verses.translation_reworded: How much more easily, then, do the holy BRAHMINS and the devoted royal saints reach that goal. Having come into this impermanent and joyless world, worship Me with devotion.

verses.title: 9.34 man-mana bhava mad
verses.sanskrit:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु ।
मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः ॥ ९-३४॥ 

ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
राजविद्याराजगुह्ययोगो नाम नवमोऽध्यायः ॥ ९॥
verses.roman:
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru
māmevaiṣyasi yuktvaivamātmānaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ 9-34

oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu
brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde
rājavidyārājaguhyayogo nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ 9
verses.colloquial:
manmanaa bhava madbhakto madyaajii maam namaskuru
maam eva eshyasi yuktva eva aatmaanam matparaayanah

om tat sat iti shriimad bhagavad giitaasu upanishatsu
brahma vidyaayaam yoga shaastre shrii krishna arjuna samvaade
raaja vidyaa raaja guhya yogo naama navamah adhyaayah 9
verses.translation_reworded:
Fix your mind on Me. Be devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, and bow down to Me. Having joined your whole Self with Me in this way, and taking Me as the Supreme Goal, you will come to Me.

Thus, in the Upanishads of the glorious Bhagavad Gita, the science of the Eternal, the scripture of Yoga, the dialogue between Sri Krishna and Arjuna, ends the ninth discourse, entitled "The Yoga of Sovereign Knowledge and the Supreme Secret."
